hook.name: DNAHook (Stockmon DNA)
hook.description: A single-pool hook for the canonical ETH/DNA Uniswap v4 pool that charges a 3%/3% buy/sell tax in native ETH via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, with a decaying buy-tax curve during a launch window when only allowlisted routers and protocol accounts may swap. Also settles the DNA leg of all liquidity changes via return deltas and maintains a truncated TWAP oracle.
